From 1e21270685ae4c14361dd501da62cdc4be867d4e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Keith Busch <kbusch@kernel.org>
Date: Tue, 22 Mar 2022 08:21:07 -0600
Subject: [PATCH] crypto: fix crc64 testmgr digest byte order

The result is set in little endian, so the expected digest needs to
be consistent for big endian machines.

Fixes: f3813f4b287e ("crypto: add rocksoft 64b crc guard tag framework")
Reported-by: Vasily Gorbik <gor@linux.ibm.com>
Reported-by: Corentin Labbe <clabbe.montjoie@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Keith Busch <kbusch@kernel.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20220322142107.4581-1-kbusch@kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Jens Axboe <axboe@kernel.dk>

diff --git a/crypto/testmgr.h b/crypto/testmgr.h
index f1a22794c404..59919a636508 100644
--- a/crypto/testmgr.h
+++ b/crypto/testmgr.h
@@ -3686,11 +3686,11 @@ static const struct hash_testvec crc64_rocksoft_tv_template[] = {
 	{
 		.plaintext	= zeroes,
 		.psize		= 4096,
-		.digest		= (u8 *)(u64[]){ 0x6482d367eb22b64eull },
+		.digest         = "\x4e\xb6\x22\xeb\x67\xd3\x82\x64",
 	}, {
 		.plaintext	= ones,
 		.psize		= 4096,
-		.digest		= (u8 *)(u64[]){ 0xc0ddba7302eca3acull },
+		.digest         = "\xac\xa3\xec\x02\x73\xba\xdd\xc0",
 	}
 };
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `crypto/testmgr.h`**
   - The expected digest values for the CRC64 test vectors have been changed from a format that uses a `u64` array to a string literal format that represents the bytes in little-endian order.
   - Specifically, the following changes were made:
     - The digest for the `zeroes` plaintext was changed from `(u8 *)(u64[]){ 0x6482d367eb22b64eull }` to `"\x4e\xb6\x22\xeb\x67\xd3\x82\x64"`.
     - The digest for the `ones` plaintext was changed from `(u8 *)(u64[]){ 0xc0ddba7302eca3acull }` to `"\xac\xa3\xec\x02\x73\xba\xdd\xc0"`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modifications in `crypto/testmgr.h` are aimed at ensuring that the expected digest values are consistent with the little-endian byte order used in the CRC64 implementation. This change addresses a bug that was reported regarding the handling of byte order on big-endian machines, ensuring that the test vectors correctly reflect the expected output of the CRC64 algorithm. The patch fixes the inconsistency introduced by a previous commit (identified by the hash `f3813f4b287e`) that added the CRC framework.

Here is the commit message:
crypto: fix crc64 testmgr digest byte order

The result is set in little endian, so the expected digest needs to
be consistent for big endian machines.

Fixes: f3813f4b287e ("crypto: add rocksoft 64b crc guard tag framework")
Reported-by: Vasily Gorbik <gor@linux.ibm.com>
Reported-by: Corentin Labbe <clabbe.montjoie@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Keith Busch <kbusch@kernel.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20220322142107.4581-1-kbusch@kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Jens Axboe <axboe@kernel.dk>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by a mismatch in the expected digest byte order for the CRC64 test vectors, which were originally defined in a way that did not account for the little-endian format used in the implementation. This inconsistency led to incorrect test results on big-endian machines, as the expected output did not match the actual output generated by the CRC64 algorithm.

Here is the patch:

 		.psize		= 4096,
-		.digest		= (u8 *)(u64[]){ 0x6482d367eb22b64eull },
+		.digest         = "\x4e\xb6\x22\xeb\x67\xd3\x82\x64",
 	}, {
 		.plaintext	= ones,
 		.psize		= 4096,
-		.digest		= (u8 *)(u64[]){ 0xc0ddba7302eca3acull },
+		.digest         = "\xac\xa3\xec\x02\x73\xba\xdd\xc0",
 	}
 };

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
.digest		= (u8 *)(u64[]){ 0x6482d367eb22b64eull },
.digest		= (u8 *)(u64[]){ 0xc0ddba7302eca3acull },
```
Reason:
The expected digest values were defined in a way that did not consider the little-endian byte order used in the implementation. This caused a mismatch between the expected output and the actual output on big-endian machines, leading to incorrect test results.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
.digest         = "\x4e\xb6\x22\xeb\x67\xd3\x82\x64",
.digest         = "\xac\xa3\xec\x02\x73\xba\xdd\xc0",
```
Reason:
The patch updates the expected digest values to be represented in a little-endian format, ensuring consistency with the implementation. This change allows the expected output to match the actual output generated by the CRC64 algorithm on both little-endian and big-endian machines.
